analysis.title: GS Futures Global Bonds CTA - Market Update - November 02, 2026
key_insights: GS Futures Sales Strats estimates trend followers (CTAs) will buy $25.5mm DV01 of global rates this week, with flow forecasts continuing to grow.
All 9 short-term trend signals are positive. One medium-term signal (JGB) is positive and the remaining 8 are close to flipping.
The heaviest expected CTA flow is in Japan, at $9.5mm DV01 of JGBs.
In the US, expected CTA demand is skewed to the front and belly of the curve: about $2.5mm DV01 each in the 2y and 5y, and $1.5mm DV01 each in the 10y and 30y.
In the desk's 'up-small' scenario, a +1sd move leads CTAs to cover their entire short position and generate net demand of about $110mm DV01 of global rates.
The up-small scenario coincides with all medium-term signals, which sit within 1sd of current levels, flipping positive. The net effect is a 4x increase in expected CTA flow.
risk_factors: The desk's flow forecasts are simulated and backtested, and GS gives no assurance the model would have operated this way in the past.
The $110mm DV01 up-small outcome depends on a +1sd move that flips all medium-term trend signals.
